parsed.title: Discussion on tax filing, domain purchase, app profitability, and source‑code access

claims.text: Paying 500 UAH to aunt Sveta can help avoid a large amount of penalties by correctly re‑filing declarations.
The inspector ignored the author's declarations for a year and only later demanded verification of all years.
The critical part is not the tax calculation itself but correctly matching each column and subtraction.
The whole re‑filing procedure typically takes about an hour with Excel.
No domain has been bought yet.
Someone suggests buying a calculator first so there will be money for the domain.
Another participant doubts anyone will buy a domain.
The domain is considered a “silly thing” that won’t evaporate even in hot weather.

topics.title: Profitability of web vs mobile apps

claims.text: Web platforms are the simplest but far less profitable than Android/iOS apps.
Web SEO is poor; even on the 10th Google page the site is not found.
There is no external traffic from social platforms or contextual ads, unlike app stores which promote new releases.
Passive ad revenue on a website is absent and user retention is near zero due to early paywalls.
Successful side‑projects use very fast delivery (under a week) and cross‑platform stacks like Flutter.
The author doubts the market will buy the product, estimating low sales.
LinkedIn audience shows decreasing technical/managerial posts, potentially affecting demand.

topics.title: Source code access, passwords and piracy concerns

claims.text: The app’s source code is not publicly available; the only password is stored locally as a 100 % discount promo code.
The author jokes about finding the password via search, implying possible easy cracking.
Participants accuse each other of piracy, referencing “bundle” price and demand for the password.
The app is positioned as a “local‑first” tool with occasional USD/UAH rate updates, but the paid bundle contains the actual value.

openQuestions.text: Is there a viable market of at least ten people willing to pay 299 UAH for the app?
